newsitem.title: USA: Triton Energy debt offering restructured.
newsitem.headline: Triton Energy debt offering restructured.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 3 - Triton Energy Corp's upcoming $400 million two-part debt offering has been restructured, according to corporate bond syndicate sources.
The first tranche consists of a $200 million five-year noncallable issue with price talk seen between 162.5 and 175 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, sources said.
The second tranche, consists of a $200 million 10-year noncallable issue with price talk seen between 190 and 200 basis points over Treasuries, sources said.
The second tranche was initially slated to come as a 30-year maturity, with a put option in the 10th year, they said.
The Ba2/BB rated deal, which could price as early as Thursday, is expected to be underwritten by Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and Salomon Brothers, sources added.
